author: melogo5
description: Online co-op for Forager (Steam) by melogo5: up to four players in one world, with shared resources, progress and dungeons, joined through Steam invites or your network. Made by melogo5, not by us. Everyone needs the same version.

needs: Your own copy of Forager on Steam, the current build (4.1.9). On any other build the mod does nothing.
Everyone you play with needs the mod too, and the same version.
steps: Press Install. The launcher puts the mod's version.dll next to Forager.exe.
Press Launch. The main menu gets a COOP button.
Host: COOP, then CREATE, then pick a save or + for a new Classic world. In the world press F2 to invite friends through Steam.
Guest: COOP, then join from the list of games on your network, or accept the Steam invite.

keys.does: Invites friends through Steam (the host, in the world).

tips: It is a beta: most of the game plays fine together, but some things can still go out of sync.
Only Classic worlds work in co-op, and Forager's own Mod API mods are not supported.
The mod is a version.dll in the game folder. Uninstalling it from the launcher removes it.

launch.hint: In the main menu pick COOP. The host presses F2 in the world to invite friends through Steam.
